firstObservationGap.cause: Docker CLI log-reader plugin outlived its timed-out parent and held the observer pipe open
firstObservationGap.action: Stopped only the verified orphan log-reader plugin, PID 47668; inference continued independently
firstObservationGap.effect: Missing intermediate resource/engine observations; completed case results retained in Gradle output

subsequentMitigation: A watchdog bounds only this experiment owner's Docker CLI LOGS plugins to approximately 15-25 seconds; PID ownership, command kind and process creation are checked
scope: The watchdog started during arm A after the first two completed cases and remains active for the rest of A and all of B. This is an observer recovery, not a token/timeout/prompt/model change. Observer timing is an additional limitation.
serverCorrelation: Only numeric evaluation timing events and their observation windows are retained; exact per-case server request IDs/timestamps are not captured
